e-GP System Operations & Compliance: Master Q&A Manual of 1,000 Step-by-Step Solutions
This definitive operational manual provides comprehensive, step-by-step procedural solutions for 1,000 questions spanning the complete e-GP public procurement lifecycle in Bangladesh. Each answer is formatted with precise navigational menus, required data fields, system validations, and security controls directly grounded in the official e-GP User Manual.
Module 1: Portal Access, Account Registration, NID & OTP Security Controls
Question 1: How to Verify National ID (NID) for PE and Vendor User Accounts
Q: How to Verify National ID (NID) for PE and Vendor User Accounts?
To verify your National ID (NID) in the e-GP system, follow these step-by-step instructions:
* Access the Verification Screen :
* If your NID is unverified, the system automatically presents the verification page upon logging into the e-GP portal.
* Alternatively, navigate to  My Account  >  Edit Profile  from your dashboard and click the  "Verify NID"  link.
* Enter Required Details :
* National ID Number : Type your NID number into the designated field.
* Date of Birth : Select your birth date matching your official NID record.
* Captcha Verification : Enter the characters displayed in the captcha image.
* Click  "Verify NID" .
* Confirm Verification Attempt :
* A pop-up message will indicate how many attempts remain. You are granted a total of  3 attempts  to verify your NID.
* Click  "Yes"  to proceed.  (Note: If all 3 attempts fail, the verification locks and you must contact the e-GP system administrator to unlock it).
* Save Verified Information :
* The system checks your data with the NID server and displays  "NID Verification Successful"  while automatically retrieving your official name (in English and Bangla).
* A green  "NID Verified"  status icon will appear next to the National ID field.
* Click the  "Update NID Information"  button to finalize and lock your verification.
Question 2: How to Complete Mobile Number OTP Verification
Q: How to Complete Mobile Number OTP Verification?
To verify your registered mobile number via One-Time Password (OTP):
* Navigate to Mobile Verification :
* Go to  My Account  >  Edit Profile .
* Locate the  Mobile Number  field and click  "Verify Mobile Number" .
* Trigger OTP Dispatch :
* Verify that your official mobile number is correctly formatted (e.g., +8801...).
* Click  "Send OTP" . The system sends a 6-digit verification code via SMS.
* Submit Verification Code :
* Enter the received 6-digit code into the  OTP Input Box  within 5 minutes.
* Click  "Submit OTP" .
* Confirm Verified Status :
* The screen will display  "Mobile Verification Successful"  and display a green checkmark next to your mobile number.
Question 3: How to Execute First-Time Login and Password Replacement
Q: How to Execute First-Time Login and Password Replacement?
To activate a newly created Procuring Entity or Vendor account:
* Retrieve Initial Credentials :
* Access your registered email inbox to find the temporary username and system-generated password sent by the e-GP Administrator.
* Access Login Portal :
* Visit https://eprocure.gov.bd and click  "Login" .
* Enter your temporary username and password, along with the captcha code.
* Force Password Reset :
* The system automatically redirects you to the  Change Password  screen.
* Enter the  Current Temporary Password  once, followed by your  New Password  twice.
* Ensure the new password meets complexity rules (minimum 8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, numeric, and special characters).
* Save & Re-login :
* Click  "Submit" . Upon receiving the success prompt, log in with your updated credentials.
Question 4: How Vendors Register a Corporate Account on the e-GP Portal
Q: How Vendors Register a Corporate Account on the e-GP Portal?
For contractors and suppliers registering on e-GP:
* Initiate Registration :
* On the e-GP homepage (eprocure.gov.bd), click  "New Tenderer Registration" .
* Provide Corporate & NID Information :
* Enter company name, legal structure (Proprietorship, Partnership, Limited, JV), TIN, Trade License number, and corporate office address.
* Enter the primary contact person's NID number, date of birth, and official email.
* Map Bank Account Credentials :
* Input corporate bank account details (Bank Name, Branch, Account Number, Routing Number) for automated security refunds and iBAS++ payments.
* Submit for Document Verification :
* Upload scanned color copies of Trade License, TIN Certificate, VAT Registration, and Bank Solvency Certificate.
* Pay the registration fee through an authorized e-GP partner bank and await system verification.

Module 2: Message Box, Alerts & Automated System Notifications
Question 41: How to Access and Manage System Notifications in the Message Box
Q: How to Access and Manage System Notifications in the Message Box?
To view and clear operational alerts in the e-GP Message Box:
* Locate Message Dashboard :
* Log into your e-GP account and click the  Message Box / Envelope Icon  on the top navigation bar.
* Filter System Alerts :
* Select alert categories from the left sidebar:  Tender Validity Extensions ,  Pre-Tender Minutes ,  NOA Alerts , or  e-PMIS Notifications .
* Review Alert Details :
* Click on any unread message subject line to open the full notification modal.
* Take Action or Acknowledge :
* Follow embedded action links (e.g.,  "Respond to Extension"  or  "View Minutes" ) or mark the notification as read.
Question 42: How Bidders Respond to Automated Tender Validity Extension Alerts
Q: How Bidders Respond to Automated Tender Validity Extension Alerts?
When a Procuring Entity requests a Tender Validity Extension:
* Open Alert Notification :
* Access  Message Box  >  Tender Validity Extension Requests .
* Review Extension Parameters :
* Note the proposed new validity expiry date and updated tender security extension deadline.
* Select Response Action :
* Click  "Agree"  to extend validity and update Tender Security through your bank, OR click  "Decline"  to withdraw your bid without penalty.
* Submit Confirmation :
* Confirm your selection. The PE's tender evaluation dashboard immediately reflects your updated decision status.

Module 3: Annual Procurement Plan (APP) Creation & Package Setup
Question 81: How Procuring Entities Create a New Annual Procurement Plan (APP)
Q: How Procuring Entities Create a New Annual Procurement Plan (APP)?
To set up an APP package in the e-GP system:
* Initiate APP Creation :
* Navigate to  APP  >  Create APP  from the PE main menu.
* Define General APP Parameters :
* Select the  Financial Year ,  Project Name / Budget Head , and  Code .
* Specify whether the APP is for Development or Operational budget.
* Add Procurement Packages :
* Click  "Add Package"  and enter Package Number, Package Description, Unit, Quantity, and Procurement Nature (Goods, Works, Services, Physical Services).
* Select Procurement Method & Financial Estimates :
* Choose Procurement Method (OTM, LTM, RFQ, DPM) and Procurement Type (NCT or ICT).
* Enter the Estimated Cost (in BDT) and select the Approving Authority (e.g., HOPE, Director, Project Director).
* Save Draft Package :
* Click  "Save as Draft"  to store package details prior to setting timeline milestones.

Module 4: APP Approval, Revisions & SLT Configuration
Question 121: How to Initiate and Approve an APP Package Revision
Q: How to Initiate and Approve an APP Package Revision?
To process an APP revision through workflow approvals:
* Initiate Package Revision :
* Navigate to  APP  >  Search APP , open the target published APP, and click  "Create Revision" .
* Modify Package Fields :
* Update estimated costs, package descriptions, or timeline dates as needed.
* Provide a formal justification for the revision in the text box.
* Configure Approval Workflow :
* Click  "Workflow Setup" , select reviewers, and assign escalation timelines.
* Submit & Approve Revision :
* The PE Creator clicks  "Submit for Approval" . The Approving Authority reviews the changes and clicks  "Approve & Publish Revision" .

Module 5: Tender Data Sheet (TDS) & Particular Conditions of Contract (PCC)
Question 161: How to Edit and Customize TDS and PCC Clauses during Tender Creation
Q: How to Edit and Customize TDS and PCC Clauses during Tender Creation?
To customize Tender Data Sheet (TDS) and PCC sections:
* Navigate to Tender Preparation Dashboard :
* Open your draft tender notice and select  Tender Preparation  >  TDS & PCC .
* Edit Mandatory Clauses :
* Click  "Edit"  next to specific clause numbers (e.g., ITT 14.1 for experience criteria, ITT 21.1 for tender security).
* Specify Financial & Technical Thresholds :
* Input required turnover amounts, liquid asset values, and specific experience years.
* Save & Validate Clauses :
* Click  "Save Clause"  after editing each section to ensure all mandatory system rules are satisfied.

Module 6: Standard Tender Documents (STDs) & Financial Forms
Question 201: How PEs Select STD Types and Fill Financial Form Summaries
Q: How PEs Select STD Types and Fill Financial Form Summaries?
To configure financial forms for Goods or Works packages:
* Select STD Template :
* Choose standard document template (e.g., e-PG3 for Goods, e-PW3 for Works) based on package estimated value.
* Configure Price Schedules & BOQ Items :
* Upload or input item descriptions, units, quantities, and duty/tax columns.
* Set Up Grand Summary :
* Link individual price schedules to the Grand Summary form.
* Validate Form Formulas :
* Run system formula checks to ensure total arithmetic auto-calculations function correctly.

Module 7: Official Cost Estimate & Password/OTP Authentication
Question 241: How PEs Upload Official Cost Estimates with OTP Security Controls
Q: How PEs Upload Official Cost Estimates with OTP Security Controls?
To upload and encrypt the Official Cost Estimate:
* Open Estimate Entry Screen :
* Navigate to  Tender Preparation  >  Official Cost Estimate .
* Input Unit Rates & Quantities :
* Enter detailed rate breakdowns matching the approved BOQ.
* Trigger Security Verification :
* Click  "Save & Encrypt Estimate" . The system prompts for your user password and dispatches a 6-digit OTP to your registered mobile.
* Submit OTP & Lock Estimate :
* Input the received OTP within 5 minutes and click  "Lock Estimate" .

Module 8: Pre-Tender Meetings & Vendor Query Management
Question 281: How PEs Manage Vendor Queries and Publish Pre-Tender Minutes
Q: How PEs Manage Vendor Queries and Publish Pre-Tender Minutes?
To manage Pre-Tender meeting queries online:
* Access Clarification Dashboard :
* Navigate to  Tender Dashboard  >  Pre-Tender Meeting .
* Review & Rephrase Queries :
* Read submitted vendor queries, rephrase if necessary for clarity, and group duplicate topics.
* Input Official Responses :
* Type official PE responses into the response fields.
* Publish Minutes :
* Click  "Generate & Publish Minutes" . All registered bidders receive automated alerts.

Module 9: Corrigendum Management & Schedule Amendments
Question 321: How to Issue a Corrigendum / Amendment for a Floating Tender
Q: How to Issue a Corrigendum / Amendment for a Floating Tender?
To amend tender dates or TDS/PCC criteria post-publication:
* Initiate Corrigendum :
* On the active Tender Dashboard, click  "Create Corrigendum" .
* Modify Affected Fields :
* Extend tender submission deadline, opening date, or edit modified TDS clauses.
* Provide Amendment Rationale :
* Enter mandatory notice justification text detailing why the corrigendum is being issued.
* Approve & Publish Corrigendum :
* Route to Approving Authority for digital approval. Upon approval, the corrigendum is published on the portal.

Module 10: Tender Opening Reports (TOR1/TOR2) & Hash Verification
Question 361: How to Conduct Online Tender Opening and Verify Bid Hashes
Q: How to Conduct Online Tender Opening and Verify Bid Hashes?
To open electronic bid submissions online:
* Convene Opening Committee (TOC) :
* TOC members log into the system after the tender submission deadline expires.
* Decrypt Bid Envelopes :
* TOC members enter their login credentials and digital keys to decrypt submitted bid packages.
* Generate TOR1 and TOR2 Reports :
* Click  "Generate TOR" . The system automatically generates TOR1 (Technical Opening) and TOR2 (Financial Opening) reports.
* Verify Bid Hashes :
* Compare submitted technical and financial form hashes against original submission receipts to confirm bid integrity.

Module 11: Tender Evaluation Committees (TEC/TSC) Setup
Question 401: How to Select and Configure Members for TEC/TSC Committees
Q: How to Select and Configure Members for TEC/TSC Committees?
To configure evaluation committee members:
* Open Committee Configuration :
* Navigate to  Tender Management  >  Committee Setup .
* Select Internal & External Members :
* Choose TEC Chairperson, Member Secretary, and external technical experts from the official e-GP expert database.
* Define Roles & Evaluation Responsibilities :
* Assign individual vs team evaluation methodologies for technical scoring.
* Issue Digital Invitations :
* Click  "Save & Notify Members"  to dispatch portal access keys to committee members.

Module 12: Financial Responsiveness & +10% Cost Limit Checks
Question 441: How e-GP Enforces the +10% Official Estimate Financial Limit
Q: How e-GP Enforces the +10% Official Estimate Financial Limit?
To process financial evaluation and enforce price limits:
* Open Financial Evaluation Dashboard :
* TEC members access  Tender Evaluation  >  Financial Matrix .
* Run Automated Price Comparisons :
* The system compares quoted financial totals against the encrypted Official Cost Estimate.
* Automated Rejection Trigger :
* Any bid exceeding the Official Cost Estimate by more than  +10%  is automatically flagged as non-responsive ( "Non-Responsive: Exceeds +10% Limit" ).
* Record Responsiveness Results :
* Save financial evaluation results to lock responsiveness statuses in TER2.

Module 13: Significantly Low-Priced Tender (SLT) Calculation
Question 481: How Automated SLT Calculations Flag Abnormally Low Bids
Q: How Automated SLT Calculations Flag Abnormally Low Bids?
To execute SLT calculations during evaluation:
* Trigger SLT Engine :
* After completing financial responsiveness checks, click  "Calculate SLT" .
* System Benchmark Computation :
* The system calculates average responsive bid prices and evaluates percentage deviations against threshold formulas.
* Identify Flagged Bids :
* Bidders falling below the SLT threshold are marked  SLT: Yes .
* Execute Detailed Cost Breakdown Analysis :
* Issue clarification requests requiring SLT bidders to provide detailed unit rate cost breakdowns.

Module 14: Technical Clarifications & Vendor Responses
Question 521: How TEC Issues Clarifications and Vendors Responds Online
Q: How TEC Issues Clarifications and Vendors Responds Online?
To manage online clarification workflows:
* TEC Issues Clarification :
* TEC Member Secretary clicks  "Issue Clarification" , types specific queries, sets a response deadline, and submits.
* Vendor Receives Notification :
* Contractor receives SMS/Email alert and opens  Dashboard  >  TEC Clarifications .
* Vendor Uploads Response :
* Contractor types explanations, attaches scanned supporting documents, and clicks  "Submit Response" .
* TEC Evaluates Response :
* TEC reviews submitted evidence online and updates bidder technical scoring.

Module 15: Online Financial Negotiation Workflow
Question 561: How to Conduct Online Financial Negotiation with First-Ranked Bidder
Q: How to Conduct Online Financial Negotiation with First-Ranked Bidder?
To execute online financial negotiation for consultancy/specialized packages:
* Initiate Negotiation :
* TEC Chairperson opens  Financial Evaluation  >  Negotiation  and selects the top-ranked bidder.
* Dispatch Negotiation Request :
* Input proposed schedule adjustments or target price reductions and click  "Send Invitation" .
* Bidder Reviews & Edits Schedules :
* Bidder opens negotiation dashboard, modifies unit prices in the electronic form, and resubmits.
* Finalize Negotiated Terms :
* TEC reviews revised financial submission and accepts negotiated totals into TER3.

Module 16: Tender Evaluation Reports (TER1–TER4) Digital Signatures
Question 601: How TEC Members Digitally Sign Evaluation Reports (TER1-TER4)
Q: How TEC Members Digitally Sign Evaluation Reports (TER1-TER4)?
To complete and digitally sign evaluation reports:
* Generate Evaluation Report :
* Member Secretary compiles evaluation data into TER1, TER2, TER3, or TER4.
* Initiate Signature Workflow :
* Click  "Send for Digital Signature"  to route the report to all TEC members.
* Execute Digital Signatures :
* Each TEC member logs in, reviews report content, enters user PIN, and applies their e-GP Digital Signature.
* Submit to Approving Authority :
* Once fully signed, the report is submitted online to HOPE / Approving Authority for approval.

Module 17: Notification of Award (NOA) & Performance Security
Question 641: How PEs Issue Notification of Award (NOA) to Winning Contractor
Q: How PEs Issue Notification of Award (NOA) to Winning Contractor?
To issue an NOA upon evaluation approval:
* Open Award Dashboard :
* Navigate to  Tender Management  >  Issue NOA  after receiving Approving Authority approval.
* Populate NOA Parameters :
* Enter Accepted Contract Amount, Performance Security Percentage (e.g., 10%), submission deadline date, and contract signing deadline.
* Issue NOA Online :
* Click  "Issue NOA" . The winning contractor receives instant notification via portal and SMS.
* Track Security Submission :
* Monitor Performance Security verification status uploaded by the issuing bank branch.

Module 18: Mandatory Beneficial Ownership Disclosures
Question 681: How Contractors Disclose Beneficial Ownership Information
Q: How Contractors Disclose Beneficial Ownership Information?
To complete mandatory Beneficial Ownership declaration:
* Access Ownership Declaration Form :
* Winning contractor navigates to  Contract Dashboard  >  Beneficial Ownership  post-NOA acceptance.
* Enter Owner Details :
* Input full names, NID/Passport numbers, nationality, and percentage of shareholding for all individuals owning >10% of company equity.
* Upload Supporting Equity Documents :
* Attach certified Shareholder Register or Board Resolutions.
* Submit Declaration :
* Click  "Submit Beneficial Ownership Declaration" . For contracts >BDT 10 Lakhs, data is published on the portal.

Module 19: Digital Signature Tool & Contract Execution
Question 721: How PEs and Contractors Execute Contract Agreements Digitally
Q: How PEs and Contractors Execute Contract Agreements Digitally?
To sign contract agreements using the e-GP Digital Signature Tool:
* Prepare Contract Agreement Document :
* System compiles general conditions, TDS, PCC, accepted financial BOQ, and NOA into contract package.
* Launch Digital Signature Tool :
* Connect authorized USB Token containing digital signature certificate and launch e-GP Signer software.
* Apply Contractor Signature :
* Contractor reviews agreement PDF, enters token PIN, and places digital signature stamp.
* Apply PE Signature :
* PE Officer reviews contractor-signed agreement, applies PE digital signature, and publishes executed contract.

Module 20: e-CMS Site Handover, Work Programs & Measurement Sheets (MB)
Question 761: How PEs and Contractors Manage Site Handover and Measurement Sheets
Q: How PEs and Contractors Manage Site Handover and Measurement Sheets?
To initiate contract implementation and record measurement entries:
* Record Site Handover :
* PE enters official Site Handover Date and Commencement Date in e-CMS.
* Contractor Uploads Work Program :
* Contractor submits activity schedules, manpower deployment, and equipment plan.
* Record Measurement Sheet (MB) Entries :
* Field engineers and contractor representatives input completed BOQ item measurements into electronic MB.
* Approve MB Data :
* Project Manager verifies measurement accuracy and locks MB entries for billing.

Module 21: e-CMS Physical Progress & Milestone Invoices
Question 801: How Contractors Track Physical Progress and Generate Payment Invoices
Q: How Contractors Track Physical Progress and Generate Payment Invoices?
To process physical progress updates and initiate interim payment invoices:
* Log Physical Progress :
* Contractor enters percentage completion against approved work activities under  e-CMS  >  Physical Progress .
* Attach Quality Check Certificates :
* Upload material test reports and inspector approval documents.
* Generate Contractor Invoice :
* Navigate to  Payments , select approved MB quantities, and click  "Generate Invoice" .
* Submit to Project Manager :
* Click  "Submit Invoice to PE" . System updates invoice status to  "Invoice Generated by Contractor" .

Module 22: Variation Orders, Time Extensions & Call-off Orders
Question 841: How to Initiate, Process, and Accept Variation Orders in e-CMS
Q: How to Initiate, Process, and Accept Variation Orders in e-CMS?
To process contract Variation Orders online:
* Initiate Variation Request :
* PE opens  e-CMS  >  Contract Amendment  >  Create Variation .
* Modify BOQ Quantities or New Work Items :
* Increase/decrease existing BOQ item quantities or add new non-BOQ work items with rate justifications.
* Send Variation to Contractor :
* PE approves variation draft and clicks  "Send to Contractor" .
* Contractor Acceptance :
* Contractor reviews modified quantities/amounts and clicks  "Accept Variation Order"  to legally execute the change.

Module 23: DDO iBAS++ Integration, Mobile OTP & Paypoint Settlement
Question 881: How DDOs Submit e-GP Bills to iBAS++ via Mobile OTP Verification
Q: How DDOs Submit e-GP Bills to iBAS++ via Mobile OTP Verification?
To transfer approved contractor bills from e-CMS to iBAS++:
* DDO Accesses iBAS++ Portal :
* DDO logs into iBAS++ web portal and navigates to  Budget Execution  >  DDO Bills  >  Goods & Services Entry (By EGP) .
* Fetch forwarded e-GP Bill :
* Select forwarded e-GP bill. System auto-populates contractor TIN, bank account, gross bill amount, and contract code.
* Enter Deductions & Sanction Order :
* Input Sanction GO number/date and enter statutory deductions (VAT, AIT, Retention Money).
* Execute Mobile OTP Verification :
* Click  "Submit to Paypoint" . DDO inputs 6-digit OTP received on mobile to authorize instant electronic transfer to Accounts Office.

Module 24: Vendor Debarment & 42-Day Temporary Suspensions
Question 921: How PEs Process Vendor Debarment and Temporary Suspensions
Q: How PEs Process Vendor Debarment and Temporary Suspensions?
To initiate vendor suspension and debarment proceedings:
* Initiate Debarment Proposal :
* PE opens  Vendor Management  >  Debarment , selects vendor profile, and specifies grounds (corrupt/fraudulent practices).
* Apply 42-Day Temporary Suspension :
* Click  "Apply Temporary Suspension" . The system automatically blocks the vendor from participating in new tenders for 42 calendar days.
* Submit Evidence to HOPE :
* Upload investigation reports, show-cause notices, and committee findings to HOPE.
* Publish Final Debarment Order :
* Upon HOPE approval, the system publishes the permanent debarment order on the e-GP homepage.

Module 25: Complaints Management & Review Panel Escalations
Question 961: How Tender Complaints are Processed, Escalated, and Freezes Enforced
Q: How Tender Complaints are Processed, Escalated, and Freezes Enforced?
To manage tender complaints and handle Review Panel escalations:
* PE Processes Initial Complaint :
* PE opens  Complaint Mgmt , selects  Accept ,  Reject , or  Seek Clarification , and submits response within 5 working days.
* Escalation to HOPE :
* If unresolved within 5 days, bidder escalates complaint to HOPE dashboard for administrative decision.
* Escalation to Review Panel :
* Bidder files appeal to independent Review Panel, uploading appeal fee receipt.
* System Operational Freezes :
* The system automatically enforces strict operational locks, blocking  NOA Issuance  and  Contract Signing  until Review Panel issues final ruling.
